levels.title: The Other Side
levels.description: Signals pass through a paired Wormhole without a physical bridge.

levels.title: The Long Way Round
levels.description: A Bounce Node sends the pulse back; the junction then takes the remaining exit.

levels.title: Right of Way
levels.description: One-way gates accept pulses only from their marked direction. Choose your Begin.

levels.title: Third Time’s a Charm
levels.description: Pick the Begin that produces enough pulses to get past the Amount Blocker.

levels.title: Two Is Enough
levels.description: Choose the Begin whose Repeater fills a two-hit target through an Amount Gate.

levels.title: The Dead End
levels.description: Single Blockers safely stop pulses. Splitters still need all their configured exits.

levels.title: Open Sesame
levels.description: Use the Begin that triggers the blue unlock before the delayed pulse arrives.

levels.title: The Red Arm
levels.description: Rotate the Alternating Node until its red arm closes the dead-end bridge.

levels.title: Turn the Tables
levels.description: Rotate the Splitter so the Begin bridge is its input and both targets are outputs.
